r: Miri! How did you get here?

dds_dark_priest2_20.m: I could not let you go alone.
r: You made me fight alone all the way here.

dds_dark_priest2_40.m: Are we going to do this now, or are you two going to talk all day?

dds_dark_priest2_50.m: That's its true form! A monster masquerading as a priest! Attack!

dds_miri_10.m: Yes, I know of you. And a little about what your brother has been up to.

dds_miri_100.m: Admirable - but only few in Dhayavar have the skills to go toe-to-toe against these monsters. No, we must stop them at the source.

dds_miri_110.m: Journey to the south of Stoutford, into the weird lands there. Investigate what's going on in the Purple Hills.
r: OK, I'm off. Stoutford ... I haven't been there in a long time ...

dds_miri_112.m: Head south through Stoutford. The Purple Hills lie between the lake region and the mountains further south.

dds_miri_114.m: You could also go west from Sullengard, but the route is longer.
r: And how do I know that I am there?

dds_miri_116.m: That's easy. The Purple Hills aren't just called that; they really have that color.

dds_miri_200.m: Ah, you're back. Too soon - did you run into any issue?
r: There's some sort of force shield blocking the path.

dds_miri_202.m: And? There must be more to it.
r: And I found this piece of Kazaul ritual again.

dds_miri_204.m: Search thoroughly around this force shield to find anything unusual.

r: When I was at the Blackwater settlement, I had used this, on the guidance of Throdna, as part of purifying the Kazaul shrine.

dds_miri_22.m: By switching Gandoren's shipment with degraded ones, you have proved not to be. Suffice to say, when I was last there I heard your brother has been up to shenanigans in Feygard.
r: How would you know that I did such things?

dds_miri_220.m: That is bad news indeed. We must act.

dds_miri_222.m: Go meet Throdna. Since he's known to ramble, just say 'Kazaul est' to focus him again.

dds_miri_25.m: As an investigator, it's my job to know. Now, buzz off, kid. Redeem yourself, if you can.

dds_miri_300.m: What did you find out from Throdna?
r: We talked about the rest of the spell to break the barrier for Kazaul.
Apart from two parts of the spell which I know, the rest of the spell to break the barrier for Kazaul is in the book Calomyran Secrets.

dds_miri_302.m: [Rolling eyes] That's not much. Go, talk to Throdna again.

dds_miri_310.m: Where can this book be found?
r: I know! I helped find this book for that old man in Fallhaven. He must still have it. Let me talk to him.
I have already visited the owner in Fallhaven.

dds_miri_32.m: By hiding the truth of the beer bootlegging from Sullengard, you have proved not to be. Suffice to say, when I was last there I heard your brother has been up to shenanigans in Feygard.
r: How would you know that I did such things?

dds_miri_320.m: Good thinking! Do that, seek the old man with the book.

dds_miri_350.m: Any news about the Calomyran Secrets?
r: I got more of the chant but I need to find another book, Azimyran Secrets, for the rest of the chant.

dds_miri_360.m: Where can that book be found?

dds_miri_370.m: No worries. I'm healed enough now.

dds_miri_372.m: You have run around enough. Let me ask around. Why don't you rest? Stroll around outside a bit to refresh!

dds_miri_410.m: About the Azimyran Secrets? Yes, my sources were most informative

dds_miri_42.m: You've aided Feygard once before. Now, investigate something for me. If you succeed, I'll tell you what I know of Andor.
r: So, what do you want from me?

dds_miri_420.m: There's an Old Hermit who lives in the mountains south of Remgard.

dds_miri_422.m: You know, at the old watch tower. The Hermit is said to have a copy of Azimyran Secrets. Go ...

dds_miri_450.m: Have you found the complete chant?
r: I haven't even found the old hermit yet.
I found the old hermit, but he hasn't given me his book.

dds_miri_452.m: You'll have to put in a little more effort. All of Dhayavar trusts you.

dds_miri_460.m: Great. And now off to the barrier! Make haste - I'll join you as fast as my injuries allow.

dds_miri_5.m: Ah, one of the kids who've been causing trouble around Dhayavar.

dds_miri_50.m: While investigating the forests east of Sullengard, slitherers got to me. Nasty little slitherers. Damned beasts.

dds_miri_500.m: It's not done yet. Can you talk to this priest? And tackle him as he deserves?

dds_miri_52.m: I need to recover from the nausea and poison.
r: Can I help you with some potions?

dds_miri_540.m: The monster is not dead. Go and finish it!

r: Yes? Hope it is worth it.

dds_miri_570.m: You are still looking for your brother?

dds_miri_580.m: I know where he is. Or better, where he will be soon.

dds_miri_590.m: Andor is going to visit Rosmara to refill his travel supplies.

dds_miri_592.m: She's the fruit lady on the road near Feygard.

dds_miri_60.m: No, thanks. I've already taken some potions, and I'm waiting for them to take effect.

dds_miri_600.m: Isn't it a lovely day? Even in here?

dds_miri_70.m: But there's something bad happening in the lands south of Stoutford, and if we don't stop it, not only Feygard, but the whole of Dhayavar will be in trouble.

dds_miri_80.m: Yeah - many weird things going on. But no time to waste.

dds_miri_90.m: In the lands south of Stoutford, there have been reports of some suspicious activities. It is said to happen in the Purple Hills there.

dds_miri_92.m: I fear if left unchecked, we might see lots of really unstoppable monsters popping up all over Dhayavar.

dds_mourning_woman_100.m: Why? That famous miracle priest who walks on lava, west of here. Do you need me anymore? Then I'm going home to mourn again.

dds_mourning_woman_110.m: Yes, you go back to your village. And we will have a chat with this famous miracle priest.

r: Miri? When did you get here?

dds_mourning_woman_60.m: I came with all haste. Too bad the poison is slowing me down.

dds_mourning_woman_62.m: [To the mourning woman] The ritual was not to bring back your husband - it is to bring Kazaul's powerful monsters into Dhayavar.

dds_mourning_woman_70.m: You lie! You don't want my happiness.

dds_mourning_woman_72.m: Do you think monsters would have assisted you? And a barrier would have sprung up? Just for one person?

dds_mourning_woman_82.m: Then why did the ritual not include something that links to your husband? Something precious to him?

dds_mourning_woman_90.m: Oh no! What do I do now? He's gone.

dds_mourning_woman_92.m: Pray where have you been praying. And tell me who put you up to this?
r: Yes, who put you up to this?

darkness_in_daylight.10: I met Miri in the Crossroads Guardhouse.
darkness_in_daylight.20: Since I had helped Ailshara, she wouldn't tell me about Andor.
darkness_in_daylight.30: Since I had hidden the truth about the bootlegging of beer from Sullengard, she wouldn't tell me about Andor.
darkness_in_daylight.40: Since I had aided Feygard once or twice earlier, she would tell me about Andor, after I had completed an investigation for her.
darkness_in_daylight.50: Since Miri was poisoned by slitherers near Sullengard, and healing is taking time, she wanted me to investigate something bad in the Purple Hills in the strange areas to the south of Stoutford.
darkness_in_daylight.60: I went to the area to the south of Stoutford and encountered an impassable force there.
darkness_in_daylight.70: There was a piece of Kazaul ritual there, which I had encountered before. I should inform Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.80: Miri asked me where I had seen this before. I told her about a task I had carried out on behalf of Throdna of the Blackwater settlement.
darkness_in_daylight.90: Miri told me to meet him and enquire further. And gave me a phrase to use whenever he started rambling.
darkness_in_daylight.100: Throdna told me it was part of a ritual to break the barrier which forms when one does a ritual to call strong Kazaul monsters.
darkness_in_daylight.110: The ritual consisted of two parts which I had found earlier, and a chant in a book called Calomyran Secrets. I need to report this to Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.120: I told Miri about finding the book for an Old Man in Fallhaven.  She told me to talk to him.
darkness_in_daylight.130: The Old Man would not let me borrow the book, so I started noting the chant in front of him.
darkness_in_daylight.140: The book contained half the chant. The rest was to be found in another book Azimyran Secrets.
darkness_in_daylight.150: Miri told me she'd trace the book. She told me to wait for her return.
darkness_in_daylight.160: Miri came back and told me that the book Azimyran Secrets was with an old hermit near Arulir mountain.
darkness_in_daylight.170: I met the old hermit and asked him about the book, Azimyran Secrets.
darkness_in_daylight.180: He refused to give it to me, so I copied the chant sitting with him. I needed to tell Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.190: Miri told me to hurry, and pass the barrier.
darkness_in_daylight.198: After destroying the ritual statue of Kazaul, beyond the barrier I found a crying woman.
darkness_in_daylight.200: She was performing a ritual that should bring her husband back to life.
darkness_in_daylight.210: Miri, who followed me, convinced the woman that it was actually an evil ritual to overrun Dhayavar with Kazaul's monsters.
darkness_in_daylight.220: The mourning woman told us that the ritual was given to her by a priest who walks on lava east of the Purple Hills.
darkness_in_daylight.230: We let the mourning woman go.
darkness_in_daylight.232: The mourning woman cried that she would never be happy again.
darkness_in_daylight.240: I had to travel to the lava wastelands.
darkness_in_daylight.250: There, after fighting monsters, I met a priest in red.
darkness_in_daylight.260: He accused me of interfering. Miri, who again followed me, revealed the red priest to be a monster.
darkness_in_daylight.280: Miri fulfilled her promise and told me that Andor would be refilling his food supplies at Rosmara's food stand.
darkness_in_daylight.300: Indeed, I have found Andor there.
darkness_in_daylight.310: He told me he couldn't come home now, and vanished.

beer_bootlegging.10: I've agreed to help the Feygard patrol captain investigate why there is so much beer on the Foaming flask tavern property.
beer_bootlegging.20: After bribing Torilo, the owner of the Foaming flask, he stated that he and other tavern owners had a 'business agreement' with a group of 'distributors'. He suggested that I ask other tavern owners for more information.
beer_bootlegging.30: After bribing Tharwyn, the owner of the Vilegard tavern, he stated as part of his 'business agreement', Dunla, the local thief, is one of his 'distributors'. He suggested that I talk to him.
beer_bootlegging.40: Dunla, the thief in Vilegard instructed me to speak with Farrick if I want to learn more about the tavern owner's 'business agreement' with their 'distributors'.
beer_bootlegging.50: Farrik told me that the beer is coming from Sullengard. I really should go there next.
beer_bootlegging.60: To earn his trust, Mayor Ale has asked that I deliver his letter to Kealwea, the Sullengard priest.
beer_bootlegging.70: I have done what Mayor Ale has asked of me as I have delivered his letter. I should now return to him.
beer_bootlegging.80: Mayor Ale has explained everything to me about the 'business agreement' with the Thieves guild. I should head back to the Foaming flask tavern and speak with the captain.
beer_bootlegging.90: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern all about the beer bootlegging operation.
beer_bootlegging.100: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern that the beer was being distributed by the Thieves guild.
beer_bootlegging.110: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern that Sullengard was responsible for brewing the beer.
beer_bootlegging.120: I lied to the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern and told him nothing about the beer bootlegging operation.

dds_nd: Darkness in the Daylight and Shadows - Non displayed

dds_nd.20: 20=Told Mikhail about meeting Andor in Miri's or Borvis' quest

feygard_shipment.10: I met Gandoren, the guard captain at the Crossroads guardhouse. He told me about some trouble up in Loneford, that have forced the guards to be even more alert than usual. Because of this, they can't do their regular errands themselves but need help with some basic things.
feygard_shipment.20: Gandoren wants me to help him transport a shipment of 10 iron swords to another guard post to the south.
feygard_shipment.21: I have agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment, as a service for Feygard.
feygard_shipment.22: I have grudgingly agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment.
feygard_shipment.25: I should deliver the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain stationed in the Foaming Flask tavern.
feygard_shipment.26: Gandoren tells me that Ailshara has expressed some interest in the Feygard shipments, and urges me to stay away from her.
feygard_shipment.30: Ailshara is indeed interested in the shipment, and wants me to help Nor City with the supplies instead.
feygard_shipment.35: If I want to help Ailshara and Nor City, I should deliver the shipment to the smith in Vilegard instead.
feygard_shipment.50: I have delivered the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern. I should go tell Gandoren in the Crossroads guardhouse that the shipment is delivered.
feygard_shipment.55: I have delivered the shipment to the smith in Vilegard.
feygard_shipment.56: The Vilegard smith gave me a shipment of degraded items that I should deliver to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern instead of the normal ones.
feygard_shipment.60: I have delivered the shipment of degraded items to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern. I should go tell Gandoren in the Crossroads guardhouse that the shipment is delivered.
feygard_shipment.80: Gandoren thanked me for helping him deliver the shipment.
feygard_shipment.81: Gandoren thanked me for helping him deliver the shipment. He never suspected anything. I should also report back to Ailshara.
feygard_shipment.82: I have reported back to Ailshara.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
